name: Ashild
title: Speaker of the Fellmoot
examine: Chosen, not crowned, and she will correct you on the difference. She says what the moot decided and not one word more.
lines: The moot decided. I only say it aloud.
We have no wall worth the name and no war in forty years. Sit with that a while.
The Crown sent a letter once. We sent back a very warm blanket.
